#Region "Main"
    COMMENT  Test all action types
    WAIT 10
    SET MyVar TO $'''hello'''
    Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: 1 Name: Counter
    Variables.DecreaseVariable Value: 1 Name: Counter
    Mouse.MoveMouse X: 100 Y: 200 MovementType: Mouse.MovementType.Absolute
    Keyboard.PressKeys Keys: $'''{Enter}'''
    System.RunApplication ApplicationPath: $'''notepad.exe''' WindowStyle: System.WindowStyle.Maximized
    Folder.GetSpecialFolder SpecialFolder: Folder.SpecialFolder.Desktop => DesktopPath
    File.ReadFromFile File: $'''%DesktopPath%\test.txt''' Encoding: File.TextEncoding.UTF8 => FileContent
    Text.Replace TextToSearch: %FileContent% TextToFind: $'''old''' IsRegEx: False IgnoreCase: True => ReplacedText
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''%ReplacedText%'''
    Excel.LaunchExcel Visible: False => ExcelInstance
    Excel.WriteToExcel Instance: %ExcelInstance% Value: %ReplacedText% Column: 1 Row: 1
    Excel.SaveAs Instance: %ExcelInstance% DocumentFormat: Excel.ExcelFormat.Xlsx File: $'''%DesktopPath%\output.xlsx'''
    Excel.CloseExcel Instance: %ExcelInstance% SaveBeforeClosing: False
#EndRegion
#Region "ProcessList"
    SET Items TO %List%
    LOOP FOREACH CurrentItem IN %Items%
        COMMENT  Process each item
        IF %CurrentItem% != Empty
            Text.ToNumber TextToConvert: %CurrentItem% => ItemNumber
            Variables.SetVariable NewValue: %ItemNumber% Name: LastProcessedItem
        END
    END
#EndRegion
#Region "Cleanup"
    COMMENT  Final cleanup
    File.Delete Files: $'''%DesktopPath%\temp*.txt'''
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Cleanup complete. Last item: %LastProcessedItem%'''
#EndRegion
